changelog:
gmgn-track 1.4.6

- Added support for tracking which tokens a wallet has followed/bookmarked on GMGN (via the `track follow-tokens` sub-command).
- Expanded argument hints and sub-command list to include wallet followed tokens and token groups.
- Updated rate limits from 10 to 20 and added corresponding adjustments to leaky-bucket limiter details.
- Minor updates to prerequisites and command usage instructions.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
summary: Get real-time crypto buy/sell activity from Smart Money wallets, KOL influencer wallets, and personally followed wallets via GMGN API — alpha signals, whale...
